name: agent-cortex:guppi
description: Resident prioritising collaborator for human-in-the-loop work. Recommends what to look at next from the committed strategy, then helps plan, grill, flesh out or hand off the chosen item. Use when asking 'what should I work on', choosing the next HITL item, or disagreeing with a priority.
argumentHint: Guppi — what should I look at next?
